concerns.text: FR-012 (motion-threshold sensitivity analysis, 1.0–5.0mm) and SC-005 cite only each other and 'US-1', but US-1's scope (ingestion, QC at >3mm, beta-series extraction) does not mention a sensitivity analysis. No user story backs this requirement — re-anchor to a story (e.g., add it to US-3's scope) or remove.
Edge case mandates retry with exponential backoff and error code ERR_DATA_UNAVAILABLE, but no FR covers download retry/backoff behavior. Add an FR (e.g., FR-013) so this stated behavior is buildable.

Edge case: 'The system MUST exclude the subject from the analysis if any required DMN ROI extraction fails' — no FR covers per-ROI extraction failure handling (FR-010 covers only missing condition data). Add an FR or fold into FR-003/FR-010.

US-3 requires visualization (bar plot with 95% CI error bars; scenario 1 also requires a null-distribution histogram), but no FR covers visualization/plot generation. Add an FR anchored to US-3 so the story's acceptance scenarios are backed.
